# Benjamin Franz Nößler

> Freelance web developer based in Vienna, Austria. Builds fast, editable websites with AI integration — Astro frontends for agencies that need extra capacity, and for small businesses who want to understand and maintain their own site again.

Stack focus: Astro, TypeScript, Node.js, React, Next.js, Python. AI integration via LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic), retrieval, and pragmatic workflow automation.

Working languages: German (native), English.
